data.title: Android HEIF图片适配指南
data.content:
一、背景介绍

HEIF（High Efficiency Image File Format）是一种高效的图像文件格式，相比JPEG可以节省约50%的存储空间。自Android 9（API 28）起，Android开始原生支持HEIF格式（通常使用.heic扩展名）。本指南将详细介绍如何在Android应用中适配HEIF格式图片。


二、适配方案概览

1、系统支持情况

✅ Android 9+ (API 28+)：完全支持HEIF解码

⚠️ Android 8.x (API 26-27)：有限支持（软件解码）

❌ Android 7.x及以下：不支持HEIF格式

2、适配核心思路

  1. 扫描适配：确保系统能识别HEIF图片

  2. 检测设备HEIF支持能力

  3. 使用合适的解码器（ImageDecoder或BitmapFactory）

  4. 处理兼容性问题（低版本回退）


三、核心实现代码

1、HEIF图片扫描适配

HEIF图片在文件系统中通常使用以下扩展名：

  1. .heic (最常见)

  2. .heif

查询图片时，需要正确查询包含HEIF图片的媒体库：

fun queryHeifImages(context: Context): List<Uri> {
    val projection = arrayOf(MediaStore.Images.Media._ID)
    
    // 关键：添加HEIF MIME类型到查询条件
    val selection = "${MediaStore.Images.Media.MIME_TYPE} IN (?, ?)"
    val selectionArgs = arrayOf("image/heic", "image/heif")
    
    val sortOrder = "${MediaStore.Images.Media.DATE_ADDED} DESC"
    
    return context.contentResolver.query(
        MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
        projection,
        selection,
        selectionArgs,
        sortOrder
    )?.use { cursor ->
        val idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Images.Media._ID)
        mutableListOf<Uri>().apply {
            while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                add(
                    ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                        MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
                        cursor.getLong(idColumn)
                )
            }
        }
    } ?: emptyList()

在使用Intent选择图片时包含HEIF类型：

fun openHeifImagePicker(activity: Activity) {
    val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_GET_CONTENT).apply {
        type = "image/*"
        // 显式包含HEIF类型
        putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_MIME_TYPES, arrayOf(
            "image/jpeg",
            "image/png",
            "image/webp",
            "image/heic",
            "image/heif"
        ))
    }
    activity.startActivityForResult(intent, REQUEST_PICK_HEIF_IMAGE)
}

2、HEIF支持检测

fun isHeifSupported(context: Context, uri: Uri): Boolean {
    // 基础系统版本检测
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return false
    
    // 检查MIME类型是否为HEIF格式
    val mimeType = context.contentResolver.getType(uri)
    val isHeif = mimeType == "image/heic" || 
                 mimeType == "image/heif" ||
                 uri.toString().endsWith(".heic", ignoreCase = true) ||
                 uri.toString().endsWith(".heif", ignoreCase = true)
    
    if (!isHeif) return false
    
    // Android 9+ 完全支持
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) return true
    
    // Android 8.x 需要额外检查
    return isHeifSupportedOnOreo(context, uri)
}

@SuppressLint("NewApi")
private fun isHeifSupportedOnOreo(context: Context, uri: Uri): Boolean {
    // 尝试解码HEIF图片以验证支持性
    return try {
        val input = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input).run {
            input?.close()
            this != null
        }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        false
    }
}

3、HEIF图片加载实现

object HeifLoader {
    
    fun loadHeifImage(context: Context, uri: Uri, imageView: ImageView) {
        if (!isHeifSupported(context, uri)) {
            handleUnsupportedFormat(imageView)
            return
        }
        
        when {
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P -> 
                loadWithImageDecoder(context, uri, imageView)
            
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O -> 
                loadWithBitmapFactory(context, uri, imageView)
            
            else -> handleUnsupportedFormat(imageView)
        }
    }
    
    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.P)
    private fun loadWithImageDecoder(context: Context, uri: Uri, imageView: ImageView) {
        try {
            val source = ImageDecoder.createSource(context.contentResolver, uri)
            val drawable = ImageDecoder.decodeDrawable(source) { decoder, _, _ ->
                // 配置解码参数
                decoder.allocator = ImageDecoder.ALLOCATOR_SOFTWARE
                decoder.isMutableRequired = false
                decoder.setTargetSize(calculateTargetSize(imageView))
            }
            imageView.setImageDrawable(drawable)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            handleDecodeError(imageView, e)
        }
    }
    
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun loadWithBitmapFactory(context: Context, uri: Uri, imageView: ImageView) {
        try {
            val inputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
            val options = BitmapFactory.Options().apply {
                inSampleSize = calculateInSampleSize(inputStream, imageView)
                inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565
            }
            
            // 重新打开流
            inputStream?.close()
            val newInputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
            
            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(newInputStream, null, options)
            newInputStream?.close()
            
            bitmap?.let { imageView.setImageBitmap(it) } 
                ?: handleDecodeError(imageView, NullPointerException())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            handleDecodeError(imageView, e)
        }
    }
    
    private fun calculateTargetSize(imageView: ImageView): Size {
        val width = if (imageView.width > 0) imageView.width else 1080
        val height = if (imageView.height > 0) imageView.height else 1920
        return Size(width, height)
    }
    
    private fun calculateInSampleSize(inputStream: InputStream?, imageView: ImageView): Int {
        if (inputStream == null) return 1
        
        val options = BitmapFactory.Options()
        options.inJustDecodeBounds = true
        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream, null, options)
        inputStream.close()
        
        val imageWidth = options.outWidth
        val imageHeight = options.outHeight
        val reqWidth = imageView.width.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1080
        val reqHeight = imageView.height.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1920
        
        var inSampleSize = 1
        
        if (imageHeight > reqHeight || imageWidth > reqWidth) {
            val halfHeight = imageHeight / 2
            val halfWidth = imageWidth / 2
            
            while (halfHeight / inSampleSize >= reqHeight 
                    && halfWidth / inSampleSize >= reqWidth) {
                inSampleSize *= 2
            }
        }
        
        return inSampleSize
    }
    
    private fun handleUnsupportedFormat(imageView: ImageView) {
        imageView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_format_unsupported)
        imageView.contentDescription = "HEIF format not supported"
    }
    
    private fun handleDecodeError(imageView: ImageView, e: Exception) {
        Log.e("HeifLoader", "HEIF decode error", e)
        imageView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_broken_image)
        imageView.contentDescription = "Error loading HEIF image"
    }
}


四、使用示例

1、Activity/Fragment中加载HEIF

// 从相册选择图片
private val pickImageLauncher = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.GetContent()) { uri: Uri? ->
    uri?.let {
        HeifLoader.loadHeifImage(this, it, binding.imageView)
    }
}

// 启动图片选择器
binding.btnPickImage.setOnClickListener {
    pickImageLauncher.launch("image/*")
}

2、处理大图加载

对于超过屏幕尺寸的大图，使用子采样视图：

<com.davemorrissey.labs.subscaleview.SubsamplingScaleImageView
    android:id="@+id/heifImageView"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"/>
 
fun loadLargeHeif(context: Context, uri: Uri, imageView: SubsamplingScaleImageView) {
    if (!isHeifSupported(context, uri)) return
    
    val bitmap = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
        val source = ImageDecoder.createSource(context.contentResolver, uri)
        ImageDecoder.decodeBitmap(source) { decoder, _, _ ->
            decoder.setTargetSize(2048, 2048)
        }
    } else {
        val inputStream = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
        BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
    }
    
    bitmap?.let {
        imageView.setImage(ImageSource.bitmap(it))
    }
}
